Name: Alex Chen 2025
Title: President
Bio: Alex is a fourth-year Chemical Engineering student with a passion for process design and sustainable energy. As President, Alex leads the council in representing CHBE students across all facets of university life at UBC.

Name: Sarah Park
Title: Vice President
Bio: Sarah is a third-year student specializing in biological engineering. She coordinates council initiatives and serves as the primary liaison between students and the CHBE faculty.

Name: James Okafor
Title: Director of Events
Bio: James organizes the council's full event calendar — from industry networking nights to the annual CHBE banquet. A third-year student who believes great events build great communities.

Name: Mei Lin
Title: Director of Finance
Bio: Mei manages the council's budget and financial planning. A fourth-year student with a keen eye for numbers and a dedication to making CHBE events accessible to all students.

Name: Daniel Reyes
Title: Director of Academic Affairs
Bio: Daniel coordinates tutoring programs, help sessions, and faculty communications. He is committed to ensuring every CHBE student has the academic support they need to thrive.

Name: Priya Sharma
Title: Director of Communications
Bio: Priya manages the council's social media presence and internal communications. A second-year student with a creative eye and a drive to keep the CHBE community informed and engaged.

Name: Liam Nguyen
Title: Director of Industry Relations
Bio: Liam builds and maintains relationships with industry partners, coordinating plant tours and networking opportunities. A fourth-year student preparing to enter the energy sector.

Name: Aisha Malik
Title: Director of Wellness
Bio: Aisha champions student mental health and wellness initiatives within CHBE. She organizes peer support programs and ensures students have access to resources when they need them most.

Name: Connor Walsh
Title: First Year Representative
Bio: Connor represents the incoming class of CHBE students, bringing fresh perspectives to the council. He is passionate about making the first-year transition as smooth as possible for new students.
